description: Road users and their trajectory data & Conflicts for Spear Motors Junction, Kampala-Uganda is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Musa Mwine, Haneen Farah. Raw data as processed by Transoft solutions using video data is included in this dataset. All the road users at the unsignalised intersection for both peak and off-peak time were analsyed to obtain the data. Road user details are also part of the data. Coverage: national (UG); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
